## 更新内容 / Changes

- 移除独立的“存储清单”功能，避免把只读统计页当成实例清理入口。
- 实例删除现在进入“已归档实例”回收站；实例页支持查看归档、恢复实例和永久删除归档。
- 新删除实例保存可验证的实例档案，不保存账号密钥；旧归档若缺少档案会标记为无法恢复，但仍可在明确确认后永久删除。
- 外部目录实例恢复时只恢复管理器登记，原外部目录始终保留。

- Removed the standalone Storage inventory feature so it is no longer presented as the instance cleanup entry point.
- Removing an instance now moves it to the archived-instance recycle bin. The Instances page can list archives, restore an instance, or permanently delete an archive.
- New removals save a verifiable instance manifest without account secrets. Legacy archives without a manifest are marked unrecoverable but can still be permanently deleted after explicit confirmation.
- Restoring an external-directory instance restores only the manager registration; the external directory remains untouched.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本验证了实例归档列表、恢复、永久删除、外部目录保护、旧归档安全处理、类型检查和实例测试。发布工作流会继续验证 macOS arm64 全量回归、打包应用和安装包校验和。

This version verifies archive listing, restore, permanent deletion, external-directory protection, safe handling of legacy archives, typechecking and instance tests. The release workflow additionally verifies the full macOS arm64 regression suite, packaged application and installer checksums.
